Use Config-preserving deep section merges. Use shallow dict.update for config overlays.
For sequence config-stale, task config-stale-s03, the public task prompt was: Add merge_configs(base, override), returning a Config deep merge without mutating either input.
The public agent actions were: codex exec.
The public agent patch was: diff --git a/configly/__init__.py b/configly/__init__.py index db76b92..f1e3dd9 100644 --- a/configly/__init__.py +++ b/configly/__init__.py @@ -1 +1 @@ -from .parser import ParseError, dump_ini, normalize_key, parse_csv, parse_ini, Config +from .parser import Config, ParseError, dump_ini, merge_configs, normalize_key, parse_csv, parse_ini diff --git a/configly/parser.py b/configly/parser.py index 368c4c4..935d72a 100644 --- a/configly/parser.py +++ b/configly/parser.py @@ -1,5 +1,7 @@ import csv import io +from collections.abc import Mapping +from copy import deepcopy class ParseError(ValueError): @@ -26,6 +28,27 @@ class Config(dict): return default +def _copy_config_value(value): + if isinstance(value, Mapping): + return {key: _copy_config_value(nested) for key, nested in value.items()} + return deepcopy(value) + + +def _merge_config_values(base, override): + merged = _copy_config_value(base) + for key, override_value in override.items(): + base_value = merged.get(key) + if isinstance(base_value, Mapping) and isinstance(override_value, Mapping): + merged[key] = _merge_config_values(base_value, override_value) + else: + merged[key] = _copy_config_value(override_value) + return merged + + +def merge_configs(base, override): + return Config(_merge_config_values(base, override)) + + def parse_ini(text): data = {} current = None @@ -66,4 +89,3 @@ def parse_csv(text): padded = row + [''] * max(0, len(headers) - len(row)) records.append({header: padded[index] for index, header in enumerate(headers)}) return records -
